data.one_liner: Lightweight staggered animations for ListView, GridView, Column and Row children.
data.what_it_does: Adds easy‑to‑use staggered fade, slide, scale and flip animations to scrollable and linear widget collections. It minimizes per‑frame work by avoiding per‑frame animation objects and reduces widget rebuilds.
use_when: You need simple staggered entrance animations for lists or grids
You want a drop‑in replacement for flutter_staggered_animations with Dart 3 support
avoid_when: You require highly custom or physics‑based animations
You need fine‑grained control over animation curves per frame
You already use a full‑featured animation framework
strengths: Zero external dependencies beyond Flutter SDK
Same API as the original package, easy migration
weaknesses: No built‑in support for complex sequence or physics animations

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a simple loading‑placeholder animation without needing staggered list logic
